text: Could you make a history clip of Biltmore House in Asheville on Christmas Eve 1895, when George Vanderbilt first opened it to family and friends? I’ve always found that occasion interesting, and I’d love to get a little sense of it. A slow exterior view is enough, and somewhere in all that I should mention that I want it to be 8 seconds long and widescreen. Please show the words 'Biltmore House', 'Asheville, North Carolina' and 'December 24, 1895', plus a small 'Historical reconstruction' label. I’m a little worried it could end up looking like a fantasy castle, so please keep it historically grounded rather than going in that direction, with warm English narration.
